policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V launches W-7 cancer drug test mission (report)
items.summary: Axios reports V launched a W-7 mission to test microgravity effects on next-gen cancer medicines (PROTAC crystallization) for potential improved absorption.

items.headline: O acquires Orchestra Bio
items.summary: O announced acquisition of Orchestra Bio to advance AI-powered drug development, integrating Orchestra’s platform/team with Rosalind and related models/tools for life sciences coordination.

items.headline: O publishes low-resource coding research
items.summary: O released research showing GPT‑6 Astra/Luna improvements on MultiLangBench and COBOL migration tasks, including reported accuracy and cost deltas vs earlier models.

items.headline: O faces FTC consumer-harms subpoenas (report)
items.summary: Axios reports FTC subpoenas involving O and Anthropic tied to consumer harms/safety investigation—potential regulatory overhang for consumer-facing usage and compliance costs.

items.headline: No new last-45-day material filing found (constraints)
items.summary: I did not find a clearly material G item within the last 45 days from an official release or direct regulatory/financing/valuation evidence using accessible sources.

items.headline: V raises $251M Series D
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing; total capital raised cited as $598M. Round led by Lux Capital and Natural Capital.
